relationships.subject: Ginkgolide B
relationships.evidence_quote: Ginkgolide B (GB) exerts an inhibitory effect on the MMP-9 protein.

relationships.subject: MMP-9
relationships.evidence_quote: β-Dystroglycan (β-DG) can anchor AQP4 protein to the end-feet membrane of astrocytes and can be cleaved by matrix metalloproteinase (MMP)-9 protein.

relationships.subject: Ginkgolide B
relationships.evidence_quote: GB treatment demonstrated the capacity to ameliorate spinal cord glymphatic function by modulating AQP4 polarity through MMP-9 inhibition

key_findings: Ginkgolide B improves spinal glymphatic function in PDN rats by inhibiting MMP-9 and preserving AQP4 polarity.
